dedupe_keys.name: wind turbines data set for south africa openstreetmap deep learning coordinate correction and capacity analysis

description: This data set gives the locations and technical attributes of wind turbines in South Africa as of 2025. It was published by Maximilian Kleebauer with an article on a wind turbine data set for South Africa from OpenStreetMap, deep-learning-based coordinate correction and capacity analysis. It holds 1,487 turbines across 42 wind farms with coordinates, turbine type, rated capacity, rotor diameter, commissioning year and administrative region. It was compiled by combining OpenStreetMap, Google and Bing satellite imagery, a RetinaNet model that corrects coordinates, and manual checks. Coverage is all of South Africa at turbine level. The data are one GeoJSON point file in WGS 84 on Zenodo (version 1.0, updated September 2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the provider claims it is the most accurate turbine data set for the country, but attributes come from public sources and can age as new farms are built. Simulation uses are wind generation and grid integration modelling and exposure analysis of wind assets. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
name: Wind turbines data set for South Africa (OpenStreetMap, deep-learning coordinate correction and capacity analysis)
